title: Finima - Security & Compliance
description: Auth attempts, rate limiting, error rates, and CORS violations for security monitoring.

layout.title: Magic Links Sent
layout.description: Rate of magic link emails dispatched for authentication.

layout.title: Magic Links Verified
layout.description: Rate of magic links successfully verified (login completions).

layout.title: Auth Failure Rate
layout.description: Proportion of magic links that were never verified. High values may indicate phishing or brute-force attempts.

layout.title: Session Revocations
layout.description: Rate of explicit session revocations (logout or forced invalidation).

layout.title: Rate Limit Hits
layout.description: Requests rejected by rate limiting. Spikes may indicate abuse.

layout.title: 4xx Errors by Endpoint
layout.description: Client error rate broken down by API endpoint.

layout.title: 5xx Errors by Endpoint
layout.description: Server error rate broken down by API endpoint.

layout.title: CORS Violations
layout.description: Requests rejected due to CORS policy violations.
